mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a contractionary supply shock combined with monetary tightening, which increases inflation expectations and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes where retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) both exceed their 12-month moving averages, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to overvaluation, with the effect being strongest over a 20-day horizon.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both exceed their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 and remains below for three consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals a misalignment between consumer spending and housing activity, which increases economic uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS declines and HOUST rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
